title: 第十一章 通幽玄金第十二章 九截剑
content_zh:
第十一章：通幽玄金买下这三样东西，苏命离开东市，又悄无声息地回到了苏家后院。
房间内，白玄清的声音响起：“我怎么之前没发现你还有这种手段？”
“你是说刚刚的买卖吗？”
“嗯！”
苏命将那三样东西摆在面前，道：“那些商贩都是人精，我越是表现得在意，他越是会漫天要价。只要估算出这三样东西的大致价值，让他稍微赚一点，他自然会心甘情愿地卖给我。”
“狡猾！”
苏命自然能听懂白玄清话里的揶揄，但他没有回应，而是拿起面前那块布满锈迹的黄铁道：“这是什么东西，为什么你对它那么在意？”
“你还记得该怎么蕴养本命剑吗？”白玄清的声音沉沉响起。
“当然记得！”苏命道：“所谓蕴养本命剑，就是将自身飞剑收入体内，用自身温养飞剑，最终以达到剑和人一同成长的目的。”
白玄清道：“别的法宝再好，对于我们剑修而言，都比不过自己的本命剑。借助本命剑，剑修能爆发出自身两倍甚至更强的战力，因此，哪怕同是剑修，凝聚本命剑的人，一定能赢那些没有本命剑的人。”
苏命恍然大悟，看着眼前的黄色锈铁道：“所以说，这块锈铁能帮我蕴养本命剑？”
“没错！”白玄清道：“如果我没看错，这应该是一块通幽玄金，传说，这种金属产自冥界和人界交汇的苦海峭壁之上，有沟通阴阳两界的能力。不过因其极其罕见，所以这个传说的真假无从考证。”
“但可以确定的是，这种金属是练剑的绝好材料。而像这么大的一块通幽玄金，恰好是你蕴养本命剑的最好选择。”
“那我现在应该怎么做？”苏命问。
“我来帮你！”
下一刻，死神塔内发出一道幽光投映在通幽玄金上，在苏命诧异的目光之中，通幽玄金不断缩小，随后化作一道流光没入了苏命气海。
苏命凝神感应而去，只见自己的气海之上静静地悬浮了三样东西。
死神塔居中耸立，一旁，死神印和这块通幽玄金静静悬浮。
白玄清道：“我已将这块玄金收入了你的气海，接下来的日子，你只需要用你的灵气洗涤它，再用自身剑气磨砺，直至它成为你的本命剑即可。”
“谢谢！”对于白玄清的帮助，苏命真诚地道了一声谢。

“谢我什么？”白玄清清冷的声音响起：“我不过是在这个死神塔内待了太久，无聊而已。”
虽然白玄清说话一直都不太好听，但苏命还是能感受到前者对自己那份关心。
随后他没多想。
现在的他，还是太弱。
只等明日一早，注定会迎来狂风暴雨。他必须在这之前，变得更强一些。
“如今修为和法宝都已经到了一个瓶颈，这样的话，那就再修炼两门武技吧。”
在前世记忆中，苏命简单寻了两门适合自己目前境界的武技。
一门为《游天步》，是一门玄阶身法武技。另一门叫《九截剑》，是一门玄阶剑道武技。
房间之中，苏命开始修炼。
有以往的经验加持，苏命没用多久，就掌握了这两门武技。
这两门功法一攻一守，再配合上绝杀一剑和死神印，这一刻，苏命信心暴涨，甚至想主动杀上柳家……
……
同一时间。
柳家！
content_en:
Chapter 11: Tongyou Xuanjin bought these three things, Su Ming left Dongshi, and quietly returned to the Su family's backyard.
In the room, Bai Xuanqing's voice sounded: "How come I didn't realize you had this method before?"
"Are you talking about the deal just now?"
"Yeah!"
Su Ming placed the three items in front of him and said, "Those vendors are all human beings. The more I show that I care, the more he will ask for prices. As long as I estimate the approximate value of these three items and let him make a little profit, he will naturally sell them to me willingly."
"Cunning!"
Su Ming could naturally understand the teasing in Bai Xuanqing's words, but he did not respond. Instead, he picked up the piece of rusty yellow iron in front of him and said, "What is this? Why do you care so much about it?"
"Do you still remember how to maintain your natal sword?" Bai Xuanqing's deep voice sounded.
"Of course I remember!" Su Ming said: "The so-called nourishing the natal sword is to take the flying sword into the body and use one's own body to warm the flying sword, and ultimately achieve the purpose of the sword and the person growing together."
Bai Xuanqing said: "No matter how good other magic weapons are, for us sword cultivators, they are not as good as our own natal sword. With the help of the natal sword, sword cultivators can explode twice as much or even stronger combat power. Therefore, even if they are both sword cultivators, those who unite with the natal sword will definitely be able to defeat those who do not have the natal sword."
Su Ming suddenly understood, looked at the yellow rusty iron in front of him and said, "So, this piece of rusty iron can help me nourish my natal sword?"
"That's right!" Bai Xuanqing said: "If I'm not mistaken, this should be a piece of Netherworld Gold. Legend has it that this metal is produced on the cliffs of the Sea of Bitterness where the underworld and the human world meet. It has the ability to communicate between the yin and yang worlds. However, because it is extremely rare, there is no way to verify the authenticity of this legend."
"But what is certain is that this metal is an excellent material for practicing swordsmanship. And such a large piece of Tongyou Xuanjin is the best choice for you to cultivate your natal sword."
"Then what should I do now?" Su Ming asked.
"Let me help you!"
The next moment, a faint light emitted from the Tower of Death and was reflected on the Tongyou Xuanjin. In Su Ming's surprised eyes, the Tongyou Xuanjin continued to shrink, and then turned into a stream of light and submerged into Su Ming's Qi Sea.
Su Ming concentrated his attention and went away, only to see three things floating quietly above his sea of ​​qi.
The Tower of Death stands in the middle, and to the side, the Seal of Death and the mysterious gold that connects the darkness are suspended quietly.
Bai Xuanqing said: "I have absorbed this piece of mysterious gold into your Qi Sea. In the following days, you only need to wash it with your spiritual energy, and then sharpen it with your own sword energy until it becomes your natal sword."
"Thank you!" Su Ming sincerely thanked Bai Xuanqing for his help.
"Thank me for what?" Bai Xuan's cold voice sounded: "I just stayed in this Death Tower for too long and was just bored."
Although Bai Xuanqing never spoke pleasantly, Su Ming could still feel the former's concern for him.
He didn't think much about it after that.
He is still too weak now.
Just wait for tomorrow morning, it is destined to be stormy. He must become stronger before that.
"Now my cultivation and magic weapons have reached a bottleneck. In this case, let's practice two more martial arts."
In the memory of his past life, Su Ming simply found two martial arts that were suitable for his current level.
One is "Wandering Heavenly Steps", which is a Xuan-level body technique. The other one is called "Nine Section Sword", which is a Xuan-level kendo martial arts.
In the room, Su Ming began to practice.
With the blessing of past experience, it didn't take long for Su Ming to master these two martial arts.
These two techniques, one offensive and one defensive, combined with the killing sword and the Death Seal, at this moment, Su Ming's confidence soared, and he even wanted to take the initiative to kill the Liu family...
…
at the same time.
Liu family!
